0022600156.text: The Clippers (1-4, 0-3 on the road, on a four-game losing streak) visit the Golden State Warriors (3-3, 1-1 at home, on a three-game winning streak) in the Clippers' sixth game of the season. Los Angeles is 4th in the Pacific, 2.5 games back, and 13th in the West, while Golden State is 2nd in the Pacific, 1 game back, and 10th in the West. Out for the Clippers are Bradley Beal (knee inflammation), Brandon Ingram (Achilles surgery), Jordan Miller (shoulder surgery), Max Strus (plantar fasciitis), and Yanic Konan Niederhauser (foot surgery), while the Warriors are without Draymond Green (rest), Jimmy Butler III (knee surgery), Kristaps Porzingis (illness), Moses Moody (knee surgery), Stephen Curry (rest), and Gui Santos, who is day-to-day with a knee issue and a game-time decision. The teams have not played each other yet in 2026-27, and the Clippers won the 2025-26 season series 3-1, including a 115-110 win in Los Angeles on April 12, 2026.
